result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. The main defect is a content mismatch: the 'Pizza' filter chip is selected, yet the lists below show non-pizza restaurants. Two smaller problems are the low-contrast secondary text and the overlapping time badge on the first carousel card.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category chip is active, but the content beneath it is not filtered. 'Green Bowl Poké', 'Smash Bros Burgers', and 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' (Ramen) all appear, so the selected filter has no visible effect.
issues.suggestion: Filter the sections by the selected category, or show a loading or empty state. If the filter is not applied, do not show 'Pizza' as selected.

issues.description: Secondary text is light gray on white or light backgrounds and has low contrast. This affects the delivery fee lines, the meta line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the '(500+)' count, and the search placeholder. The inactive nav labels (Search, Orders, Profile) are also faint.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and inactive icon colors to meet WCAG AA contrast of at least 4.5:1.

issues.description: The time badge ('15–25 min') on the first carousel card overlaps the plate illustration and sits against the card's left edge, so it looks crowded. The badge placement also differs slightly from the other cards.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent badge positioning and padding on every card, and keep it clear of the key image content.

issues.description: The 'Order now' promo banner has decorative translucent circles that are clipped awkwardly at the right and bottom edges. The white-on-green subtext is small and only moderately contrasted.
issues.suggestion: Reposition or simplify the decorative shapes and increase the subtext size or contrast.
